blocks.text: Do coils ek doosre ke qareeb rakhi hain (Fig. 17.20). Jo coil switch S aur rheostat ke zariye battery se juri hai use primary coil kehte hain; jo galvanometer se juri hai woh secondary coil hai. Rheostat ki resistance badal kar primary ka current badlen to aas paas ka magnetic flux badalta hai. Secondary coil primary ke magnetic field mein hai, is liye badalta flux secondary se bhi guzarta hai aur secondary mein emf paida hoti hai.

blocks.title: Mutual induction
blocks.text: Jab ek coil ka badalta current doosri coil mein emf paida kare, to is amal ko mutual induction kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Primary coil, jo switch aur battery ke zariye rheostat se juri hai (current Ip), secondary coil ke saath sire se sira rakhi hai jo galvanometer se juri hai (current Is). Magnetic field lines primary se secondary mein guzarti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.20: Do coils ke darmiyan mutual induction maloom karne ka circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Primary ka current badalne par us ka magnetic field badalta hai; yeh field secondary se bhi guzarta hai, is liye secondary mein emf paida hoti hai aur galvanometer ki sui hilti hai. Current mustaqil ho to field nahi badalta aur galvanometer zero par rehta hai.

items: Primary aur secondary dono coils ke chakkaron ki tadaad.

Coils ke darmiyan medium ki magnetic permeability.
Jis madde par coils lapeti gayi hain us ki qism (nature).

blocks.text: Faraday's law se secondary mein emf, secondary ke flux ki tabdeeli ki raftar se milti hai:

Yani secondary mein paida emf primary ke current ki tabdeeli ki raftar ke mutabiq hai. Minus ka nishan batata hai ke paida emf aisi simt mein hai jo primary ke current ki tabdeeli ki mukhalfat kare (Lenz's law). Mutual inductance M ki miqdar:

blocks.title: Mutual inductance
blocks.text: Secondary mein paida average emf aur primary ke current ki tabdeeli ki raftar ki nisbat (ratio) mutual inductance hai.

M ki SI unit V s A⁻¹ hai, jise Joseph Henry ke naam par henry kehte hain. Do coils ki mutual inductance 1 henry hai agar primary mein current 1 ampere fi second ki raftar se badle aur secondary mein 1 volt emf paida ho.

Mutual inductance bohat se aalaat mein kaam aati hai: transformer, electric motor, generator waghera. Digital signal processing mein bhi is ka bara kirdar hai, aur pacemaker aur metal detector jaise aalaat mein bhi istemal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Kya aap jante hain pacemaker kaise kaam karta hai? (Kitab tasveer dikhati hai: seene mein jild ke neeche pacemaker, aur us ki taarein (pacemaker leads) dil ke right atrium aur right ventricle tak.)

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: pacemaker kaise kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Pacemaker ek chhota battery wala aala hai jo seene mein jild ke neeche rakha jata hai; us ki taarein (leads) dil ke right atrium aur right ventricle tak jati hain. Yeh dil ke apne bijli ke signals mehsoos karta hai, aur jab dil bohat aahista ya be-qaida dhadke to chhote bijli ke pulses bhejta hai jo dil ke muscles ko theek raftar se sukarte hain.

blocks.title: Izafi misal (kitab mein nahi)
blocks.problem: Do coils ki mutual inductance 0.2 H hai. Primary ka current 50 A s⁻¹ ki raftar se badal raha hai. Secondary mein paida emf nikalein.
steps: εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt (miqdar ke liye minus chhor dein)
blocks.answer: εₛ = 10 V (aisi simt mein jo tabdeeli ki mukhalfat kare)

blocks.prompt: Primary mein mustaqil (steady) current ho to secondary mein emf kyun nahi aati?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke emf primary ke current ki tabdeeli ki raftar par munhasir hai (εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt). Mustaqil current ka flux nahi badalta, is liye ΔIₚ/Δt = 0 aur koi emf paida nahi hoti.

items: Mutual induction: primary ka badalta current secondary mein emf paida karta hai.
Nₛφₛ = MIₚ; εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt; unit henry.
M chakkaron, area, permeability, core ke madde, faasle aur rukh par munhasir; istemal: transformer, motor, generator, metal detector.
